Each 2025 wedding guest cost $292 (The Knot).

That's $34,200 total, across an average of 117 guests.
Venue averaged $12,900; catering $80 a person ($9,360 for 117); photographer $3,000. Venue plus food: roughly 65% of the bill (our estimate from those averages).
Average cost: $19,000 in 2020, $35,000 in 2023, $34,200 in 2025.

Sources: The Knot 2026 Real Weddings Study (10,474 couples married in 2025); earlier Knot studies.
News and education, not financial advice.
